title: Auritus-web README and Auritus README both claim to be the site
description:
**Problem**
The Auritus-web README and the Auritus README each describe themselves as the home of the aurit.us site, so it is unclear which repository is canonical.

**Evidence**
Auritus-web README.md and Auritus README.md / site/README.md. Filed on the Auritus board because Auritus-web has no board.

**Fix**
Decide which repository owns the site and say so in both READMEs.

**How to verify**
Both READMEs name the same canonical repository for aurit.us.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
